name: BoardWorkspace - Working
description: The surface a person actually uses: the board, and the conversation in the corner of it, with an agent attached and a round in progress. The chat belongs to the whole map rather than to one card — that is the true relationship, the map being what the conversation has produced so far — but it says so by sitting OVER the board in one corner rather than across the middle of it, because a panel that covers the subject has stopped being a conversation about anything you can see.
